Description
Returns the same result as the OpenSSL function
X509_verify_cert_error_string()
. Values for the
<X509 verify
error code>

SSL::verify result
command returns.

Returns the same result as the OpenSSL function
X509_verify_cert_error_string()
. Values for the
<X509 verify
error code>
argument must be the same values as those that the
SSL::verify result
command returns.
